Fig. 48. Coelophysis bauri. Two pieces of right ilium with restoration in dotted line;

a lateral view, b upper view of lower part, c posterior view of upper part showing medial crest and real breadth of posterior spine which is oblique in a and therefore seems narrower. X 1/2. (Type: Cope, 1. c. 1887, p. 224 "No. 1 of C. longicollis"). Fig. 49. Coelophysis bauri. Proximal posterior part of left lschium; a lateral, b upper, c posterior, d lower view. X 1/2. (Type: Cope, 1. c. 1887, p. 226). Fig. 50. Coelophysis bauri. Distal part of left lschium; a lateral, b upper, c end view. X 1/2. (Type: Cope, 1. c. 1887, p. 226). Fig. 51. ?Ccelophysis bauri. Proximal extremity of ftbula (?), two views. X 1/2. Fig. 52. Coelophysis willistoni Cope. Upper arch of cervical vertebra, anterior part. x 1/2. Fig. 53. Coelophysis willistoni. Centrum of dorsal vertebra, lateral view. X 1/2. (Type: Cope, 1. c. 1887, p. 226 " C. bauri".) Fig. 54. Coelophysis willistoni. Sacrum, consisting of four vertebra; a left, b lower view. Above the vertebrae is a pubic process of an ilium of C. bauri. X 1/2. (Type: Cope,

1. c. 1887, p. 226 "C. bauri ")
